_comment: Committed connection config — env-var placeholders ONLY, never a real token (tracked file). The gateway connection authenticates when AURA_MCP_TOKEN is set (an aura_... management token minted in Aura → Fleet → Agent Tokens): on devices via the shell env, in claude.ai cloud environments via the environment's env vars. The :- default keeps the config parseable when the variable is unset; the header then goes out with an empty bearer and the gateway answers 401, which the client reports as AUTH_HEADER_REJECTED (since Aura #454 the message says 'no credential presented', so it is not mistaken for a bad token). See files/references/connect.md for token minting, scoping, the high-risk-write opt-in, and how to tell a substitution problem from a rejected credential.
